minutes.headline: Conservation Commission continued the 390 Howard St delineation pending peer review and approved a 20 Kilburn St Lot 3 house with conditions.
minutes.summary: The commission handled a long run of wetlands hearings. It issued a negative determination for 20 Kilburn Street Lot 1 and approved Lot 3 with conditions. It continued Lot 2, 390 Howard Street, 255 Sunny Hill Road and 171 Arbor Street to February 21. It heard the Lake Shirley annual report and an extension request, approved a certificate of compliance for 120 West Street, authorized an enforcement order, and approved a boiler tank purchase for the Hollis Road house.

public_comment.topic: Asked for permission to cut three dead or dying pines near his house. Told to work with the administrator on the filing.
Wanted to comment on the 255 Sunny Hill Road delineation. Deferred to February 21 because the hearing was continued.
Raised flooding and catch basin concerns on Lemster Road for the Lot 1 request.
Described flooding on Kilburn Street and asked that the three lots be considered together.
Said the area is always wet and questioned building there.
Asked about standing water on Lot 2. The chair explained jurisdiction and the delineation process.
Asked whether runoff at Lot 3 goes into the wetland. The applicant confirmed it does.

budget_items.topic: Third-party peer review of wetland delineation at 390 Howard Street
budget_items.what_was_said: The applicant pays the peer reviewer through the town office, which contracts the reviewer. The applicant objected to the scope of one bid and asked to talk to the interim land use director about it.
The cost was charged to the Hall's account as budget support.

budget_items.topic: Hot water holding tank replacement, Hollis Road house
budget_items.what_was_said: Cam's Heating quoted the replacement, and the commission approved a not-to-exceed amount. The December service invoice was still outstanding.
The chair suggested paying for removal of a shed at 950 Chase Road from the fund after the timber harvest.

budget_items.topic: Fire department pumping of Hollis Road basement
budget_items.what_was_said: It was unclear whether the fire department will bill for the pumping.

decisions.decision: The administrator will call Richard Parson about filing to remove the three trees, and he will email her his contact information.
The applicant at 390 Howard Street may talk with the interim land use director about peer reviewer names and scope. The scope will return to the commission before a reviewer is engaged.
The administrator will contact McCarthy Engineering about the 171 Arbor Street applicant's absence and confirm which drawings the commission holds.
The commission leaned toward 25-foot boulder spacing. For the Lot 2 force main it wants a construction schedule with the work done in about a week and stabilized within seven days.
The Lake Shirley extension request will be put on a future agenda as an extension request. The state allows only three years, and the applicant already sent its letter.
The 32 Courtland Circle detention pond item was struck from the agenda until the homeowners association makes a real ask.
Hollis Road invoices should be emailed to the commission's office address so commissioners are kept out of the flow.
Members should send Mac class choices to staff by Friday so a purchase order can be raised.
Grant updates, conservation land updates and other routine business were deferred to the next meeting.

what_happened.line: The Conservation Commission voted to approve the 20 Kilburn Street Lot 3 notice of intent, conditioned on a revised plan with boulder spacing and erosion protection.
It continued the 390 Howard Street wetland delineation to February 21 so a third-party peer review can be arranged, with the scope to return to the commission first.
It issued a negative determination for 20 Kilburn Street Lot 1 after abutters described flooding, and continued Lot 2 to February 21.
It authorized the administrator to issue an enforcement order on the culvert at 780 Northfield Road, and approved a certificate of compliance for 120 West Street.
It approved a not-to-exceed purchase of a replacement hot water heater for the Hollis Road house, and continued 255 Sunny Hill Road and 171 Arbor Street to February 21.

why_it_matters: Residents near Kilburn Street raised flooding and runoff concerns, and the decisions on that three-lot project now rest on a revised plan for Lot 3 and a further hearing on Lot 2.
At 390 Howard Street the applicant pays for peer review through the town office, so the reviewer's scope and cost affect what a wetland delineation takes to settle.
watch_next: February 21 continued hearings: 20 Kilburn Street Lot 2, 390 Howard Street, 255 Sunny Hill Road and 171 Arbor Street.
The peer reviewer scope for 390 Howard Street, which is to return to the commission before a reviewer is engaged.

reconciliation.summary: The two records agree on most votes, and every shared vote passed unanimously. They differ on one vote ours lists as not audible, on one vote and one dollar figure that appear in only one record, and on the hot water heater price.
